title: General building
summary: Groundworks, brickwork, walls, patios and repairs, handled by a reliable local team.
intro: Not every job is a big project. We're happy to take on smaller building work and repairs across East Ayrshire.
body:
## Typical jobs

- Garden walls and boundary walls
- Patios, paths and steps
- Groundworks and drainage
- Brick and block work
- Garages and outbuildings
- General repairs and maintenance

Get in touch with a description and a few photos and we'll let you know how we can help.
